info.title: Actava.ai Cura API
info.summary: OpenAI-compatible API for Cura 1T, Actava.ai's healthcare language model.
info.description:
The Cura API serves Cura 1T, Actava.ai's 1T-parameter healthcare language model, through an OpenAI-compatible interface at https://inference.actava.ai/v1. Existing OpenAI SDK code works by changing the base URL and the model id (`actava/cura-soar`).

**Authentication.** Every request carries `Authorization: Bearer <API key>`. Keys are issued by Actava.ai — request access at https://forms.gle/hLfVUq1pBPRNojkj8.

**Surface.** Only the two operations described here are served; any other path answers 404 with code `NO_RULE_MATCHED`. The model reasons before answering (thinking is on by default), accepts text and images, supports tool calling, streaming, JSON mode and automatic prompt caching, and has a 256K context window.

**Errors.** Non-2xx responses carry a JSON envelope with a human-readable message, an error type and, where applicable, a machine-readable code. Retry 429 and 5xx with exponential backoff; fix 400s rather than retrying them.

Cura 1T is a research model, not a medical service, and not a substitute for a clinician. Benchmark scores do not establish safety for unsupervised clinical use.
